newsitem.title: USA: Guaraty Financial offering gets SEC nod.
newsitem.headline: Guaraty Financial offering gets SEC nod.

text.p: Guaranty Financial Corp said Friday its public offering for 575,000 common shares at $8.50 has been declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Guaranty, a bank holding company, said net proceeds from the offering will be about $4.49 million. The money raised will be used for general corporate purposes, it said.
The offering was sold on a best efforts basis by McKinnon & Co Inc and nine participating dealers, it said.
Guaranty is traded on Nasdaq's SmallCap market. The company said it has applied to have the stock listed on Nasdaq's national market system.
